method.reader: mne.io.read_raw_edf(preload=False); raw.get_data() one continuous run at a time
method.transformations: none: no filtering, reference change, rounding or scaling beyond MNE EDF decoding
method.canonical_numeric_hash: SHA256 of netbci-numeric-array-v1 NUL, sorted compact JSON dtype <f8/shape/order C, NUL, little-endian float64 C-order values
method.value_payload_hash: SHA256 of little-endian float64 C-order values, with no EDF header/annotation bytes
method.identity_scope: bitwise identical canonical returned numerical arrays; dimensions included; channel order separately validated
method.task_window_policy: all actual labeled source [start_sample, stop_sample_exclusive) intervals, including the real short event
method.near_similarity_note: This is an exact numerical identity audit. Different hashes do not rule out near similarity; no correlation/distance threshold is used.
method.hash_comparison_note: Identity uses cryptographic numerical fingerprints; EDF file SHA is recorded independently and includes metadata.

timing: raw numerical-content audit required before any expanded nineteen-ID model fitting
role_source: fixed configuration; source session train runs01-04/query05-06; later all runs; no model output read

planned_partition_content_overlap.interpretation: Exact content overlap between source training and later queries despite distinct source event IDs; affected later-session model scores are not independent cross-session generalization evidence.

limitations: Exact identity applies to the available EDF derivative numeric arrays, not independently read original BrainVision EEG.
Original header paths, data/marker filename fields and hashes establish distinct metadata identities; they cannot establish distinct or identical underlying original signal contents.
A blank acquisition-reference field does not identify the acquisition reference.
No cause (conversion, provenance mapping, acquisition, human physiology or behavior) is inferred from exact derivative repetition.
Existing numerical analysis and cohort membership are preserved; no participant or event is excluded by this audit.
Near-zero geometry or identical spectral summaries of repeated derivatives are not independent biological-stability evidence.
